_description: A SMALL smoke eval-set for the code corpus (kind=code), plan docs/work/2026-08-21-code-search-implementation-plan.md §12.2 H8/WP8. Queries target THIS repo's own src/ tree as the corpus — run memory_watch_add or memory_ingest_directory on this repo's src/ against a scratch bank, then drive scripts/src/retrieval_tuning/evaluate.py with ScratchServer.search(entry) for entry in this file's 'queries' list; each entry's 'kind': 'code' reaches memory_search's code section (mcp.py/server.py plumbing, this same task).
_purpose: Sanity check ONLY: does memory_search kind=code return the right file for an obvious query on a small, always-available corpus. NOT a tuning or gate corpus — 8 queries is far too few to adjudicate a chunker or model arm (ADR-0056's failure mode).
_deferred: The full multi-repo eval-set (2-3 permissive-license repos incl. a mandatory Python one, plan §3.9/§12.4 OQ5) is DEFERRED pending owner approval of the specific repos — it is NOT this file, and this file does not become it by growing. Do NOT vendor external repos here.
_scoring: expectedHash is intentionally null on every entry — the code corpus has not been ingested anywhere yet, so no chunk hash exists to pin. scoring.py's resolve_gain falls back to expectedSource (source_file suffix match), which is all these entries rely on.
